name: Helion
oneLine: Fusion-energy company pairing raw lab footage with a cool, mono-labelled, scroll-pinned technology story.

palette.note: Near-black behind the full-bleed lab video hero
Cool pale blue-grey page background; also the light text color over video
Deep navy body text and the solid nav-bar fill
Slightly darker navy for secondary panels
Grey for small 'Skip' affordance and secondary labels
White 'CAREERS' button, the only filled control, detached from the nav bar

type.note: 55px light (~300) all-caps headline 'FUSION BUILT TO POWER OUR WORLD', tight leading, first line indented as a ragged step
14-19px regular sentence case, e.g. 'Discover our technology'
13-14px uppercase nav items with generous letter-spacing; most frequent family on the page

layout: Hero is a full-viewport video with the headline bottom-left and nothing else: no subhead, no CTA in the hero body.
Centered navy nav capsule (~640px) with the primary CTA split off as a separate white pill to its right.
Technology section is a pinned, viewport-height stage on pale #EEF2F5 with a single centered caption flanked by two tiny square bullets, plus a 'Skip' link below.
motion: Hero background is looping video (2 videos on page) of the machine with a technician, slow handheld drift.
Technology section is a scroll-pinned sequence: both scroll captures show the same empty stage with 'Discover our technology' because content is scrubbed by scroll on a canvas (1 canvas detected).
(inferred) The step-indented two-line headline animates in line-by-line, suggesting a staggered mask reveal.
(inferred) A 'Skip' control lets users bypass the long scroll-jacked animation, acknowledging its length.
interactions: 'Skip' link under a pinned scroll story to jump past the animation.
Mono uppercase nav with machine names (POLARIS, ORION) as top-level items.
steal: A 'Skip' link under any pinned scroll-scrubbed sequence, for our model-architecture walkthrough so recruiters can jump to results.
Mono uppercase nav labels with a separated, inverted primary pill for our top bar (e.g. 'READ PAPER' detached from section links).
Cool blue-grey #EEF2F5 page ground with navy ink as the light-mode base of our methods/results pages instead of pure white.
leave: Scroll-jacked stages that render as an empty screen until JS paints; screenshots and slow devices see a blank page, and our figures must be readable without scrubbing.
Hero with no explanatory subhead: fine for a famous brand, but our visitors need one line saying what the model does.
